purpose: Autonomous earnings-options trading research on the 300-name, 2018-2025 earnings_vol cache: broaden strategy families, entry/exit timing and historical-only signal filters; freeze candidates on a selection sample; validate outside it; preserve every result.

data.cache: wrds_studies/earnings_vol (WRDS OptionMetrics + I/B/E/S, restored from nicjia/options-data release cache-2026-10-02)
data.universe: 300 securities fixed at the 2017-12-31 formation date by the collection protocol; later-delisted names retained
data.quotes: Closing best bid/offer for all listed expiries within ~40 calendar days, sessions E-2..E+3 around each event
data.stocks: Daily close, total return, cfadj and volume, 2015-2025

prior_exposure: A previous study (research4) used this cache and inspected a long-straddle rule in 2022-2025, and earlier repository experiments examined some of these names and years. No sample here is a pristine untouched holdout; the stage-D test is out-of-selection for this protocol only.
event_alignment: E = first stock session on or after the I/B/E/S announcement date in events.csv. Sessions come from the stock-price calendar. An event is usable only if quotes exist for its entry session.
information_set: Decisions at an entry close use: stock closes/returns up to that close; option quotes at that close; earlier events whose exit session precedes the entry session (their stock moves and their own E-1 implied moves). Nothing dated after the entry close enters a signal, a strike/expiry choice, a liquidity gate or a filter.

execution.primary: Closing midpoint for every leg at entry and exit (live analogue: decide ~15 minutes before the close)
execution.cost_sensitivities: Pay 25% and 50% of each leg's quoted half-spread at entry and exit
execution.fees: $0.65 per option contract per side; packages are one contract per leg (calendars and condors included)
execution.missing_exit: If any leg lacks a usable exit quote (bid/offer absent or offer <= 0), the trade is unresolved. Unresolved trades are counted and disqualify a candidate if more than 1% of its trades are unresolved; they are never silently dropped. Exits with bid 0 and positive offer use the midpoint.
execution.signal_lag_check: Frozen policies are re-run with signals and contract choices taken one session before entry (entry contracts fixed in advance; missing entry quotes cancel the trade).

contracts.front_expiry: First expiry with exdate >= max(exit session date + 1 day, E+1 session date) and exdate <= E + 30 calendar days, quoted at entry
contracts.back_expiry: Next quoted expiry after the front expiry with exdate <= front + 45 calendar days (calendars only)
contracts.atm_strike: Front-expiry strike with both call and put quoted, nearest the entry stock close
contracts.implied_move_M: Front ATM straddle mid / stock close at the entry session

families.long_strangle: Buy put nearest S(1-0.5M) and call nearest S(1+0.5M), strikes strictly OTM
families.short_iron_fly_1x: Sell ATM call+put; buy put nearest K-1.0*straddle and call nearest K+1.0*straddle
families.short_iron_condor: Sell put nearest S(1-0.5M), call nearest S(1+0.5M); buy put nearest S(1-1.5M), call nearest S(1+1.5M)
families.short_iron_condor_wide: Sell put nearest S(1-1.0M), call nearest S(1+1.0M); buy put nearest S(1-2.0M), call nearest S(1+2.0M)
families.call_calendar: Sell front ATM call, buy back-expiry call at the same strike
families.straddle_calendar: Sell front ATM straddle, buy back-expiry straddle at the same strike

risk_normalization: Return on risk = net P&L / risk at entry mids: long packages and calendars use the debit; short packages use max(wing width on either side) - credit. Packages with risk < $20 per unit, non-positive credit (shorts) or debit (longs/calendars), or degenerate strikes are skipped.

liquidity.standard: Every leg at entry: bid > 0, mid >= 0.05, open interest >= 10; (ask-bid)/mid <= 0.25 for ATM/short legs and calendar legs, <= 0.50 for long wings; stock close >= $10
liquidity.tight: Standard, plus (ask-bid)/mid <= 0.10 on ATM/short/calendar legs and <= 0.25 on wings

dividends: Skip if a cash distribution ex-date falls after entry and on/before the front (calendars: back) expiry, using the distribution file; this uses scheduled ex-dates which are normally announced in advance.

timings.after_release: Exit at close of E if, among the name's last 8 earlier events (at least 4 required), the absolute stock return E-1->E exceeded E->E+1 in a majority; else exit at close of E+1. Uses only earlier events.

signals.R: M / H. H = mean over the name's last 8 earlier events (minimum 6) of E|J_k + s Z|, J_k = log(close E_k+1 / close E_k-1) for earlier events, s = EWMA(lambda=0.94 on squared daily log returns over the 60 sessions before entry, excluding sessions E_k-1..E_k+1 of earlier events) * sqrt(max(sessions from entry to front expiry - 2, 0)/252). Z standard normal; closed form.
signals.TS: Front ATM implied vol / back ATM implied vol at entry, Black-Scholes with r=0 and spot as underlying, from ATM call and put mids averaged; requires a back expiry
signals.HR: Mean over the name's last 8 earlier events in this cache (minimum 4) of |J_k| / M_k, with M_k the E_k-1 close implied move of the event-k front expiry

filters.assignment: short_vol = short_iron_fly_1x, short_iron_fly_2x, short_iron_condor, short_iron_condor_wide, call_calendar, straddle_calendar; long_vol = long_straddle, long_strangle. A missing signal value fails any filter that uses it ('none' never fails).

candidate_grid: Every family x every timing x its filters x {standard, tight} liquidity. The full list is generated by research5.candidates and its hash recorded in the frozen file.

samples.A_selection: Events with E in 2018-2021, name half A
samples.B_cross_section: Events with E in 2018-2021, name half B
samples.C_validation: Events with E in 2022-2023, all names
samples.D_test: Events with E in 2024-2025, all names (quotes end 2025)

inference.unit: Equal-risk event return; GOOG/GOOGL-type duplicate issuer events averaged within issuer-event
inference.cluster: Calendar week of E (Monday-based ISO week)
inference.screening_interval: Cluster-robust normal 95% interval over weekly clusters (selection stage, all candidates)
inference.reported_interval: Weekly-cluster bootstrap 95% percentile interval, 2000 resamples, seed 20261002 (frozen policies)
inference.multiple_comparisons: Max-t over eligible stage-A candidates via centered weekly-cluster bootstrap (500 resamples)

selection.eligibility: >= 150 issuer-events, >= 40 issuers, <= 1% unresolved, mean > 0 at 25% half-spread cost, mean > 0 excluding the best 5 events
selection.objective: Cluster-robust lower 95% bound of mean midpoint return on risk
selection.frozen_set: Up to 5 policies: best eligible candidate per family group in order of objective, at most one per family, taken from the top of the ranking; plus the autonomous walk-forward selector itself
selection.no_retuning: Stages B, C and D are gates. Nothing observed there changes the frozen set.

qualification: A frozen policy qualifies only if, at midpoint, the weekly-cluster bootstrap lower 95% bound is > 0 in each of B, C and D; mean > 0 at 25% half-spread cost in each; mean > 0 excluding the best 5 events in D; >= 100 events and >= 40 issuers in D; max-t adjusted stage-A p < 0.05. Anything else is reported as not qualified with its numbers.
walk_forward: Autonomous selector: for each year Y in 2020..2025 apply the same eligibility and objective to all events with E before Y (both name halves; eligibility minimum scaled to 100 events) and trade the winner during Y. Concatenated out-of-sample years are evaluated with the same statistics.
portfolio: Illustration only for frozen policies: $100,000 start, 2% of current equity at risk per trade (max-loss basis, whole contracts allowed fractional for comparability), concurrent positions allowed, P&L realized at exit. Not a verified brokerage simulation.
preservation: Every candidate's statistics in every stage that is run, every trade record, coverage counts and skip reasons are written to the private results directory; outputs are created exclusively and never overwritten. Post-freeze diagnostics of all candidates in B/C/D are labelled diagnostic and cannot alter the frozen set.
limitations: I/B/E/S announcement dates are retrospective; release times are inferred only from earlier stock moves
Closing midpoint fills are assumed, not demonstrated
American early exercise and assignment ignored except via the dividend exclusion
Static 2017 formation universe; later IPOs excluded
Margin, buying power and borrow not modeled beyond max-loss risk
Implied vols use r=0 and spot (no dividend/forward adjustment); used only for the TS ratio
